children: Robinhood ecosystem meme coins fell broadly on September 7, with MEME, PONS, AI, CASHCAT, and microduck all posting declines. According to Odaily, MEME's market value was $96 million, down 25.8% over six hours, while PONS fell 14.8% over 24 hours to $560 million. AI was down 14.9% over 24 hours to $199 million, CASHCAT fell 7.3% to $227 million, and microduck dropped 34.8% to $23.11 million over 24 hours.

title: Robinhood Ecosystem Meme Coins Fall on September 7
